ghost.sample:
Zog was a small dragon. He lived behind the moon. He ate clouds, and he loved them.  
One day, Zog saw a cloud fall down and slow. It looked soft and fluffy. Zog wanted it. But the cloud was too far.  
Zog flew up, up, up. He went over the stars. He went to the moon, then behind it, to his home.  
There, Zog saw one more cloud. It was tiny and shy.  
"Hello," said Zog. "I can eat you now."  
He smiled and took a little bite. The cloud was sweet and cool.  
Then Zog saw another cloud. He ate that one too.  
Soon the sky was clear and bright. Zog felt happy and full.  
He sat behind the moon and looked at the stars.  
"Good night," he said. And he smiled all night.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lived in the sky. Sisi liked to sing songs.  
One day, Sisi saw a bird in the sky. The bird looked sad.  
"Why are you sad?" asked Sisi.  
"I lost my song," said the bird.  
Sisi thought hard. Then Sisi sang a soft song. The bird listened.  
The bird smiled big. "I hear it now!" said the bird.  
Sisi sang again. The bird sang too.  
Soon they sang a happy song together.  
More birds heard them. They came up in the sky.  
Now the sky was full of song. Sisi felt very proud.  
The bird said, "Thank you, Sisi."  
Sisi smiled and sang all day. The end.

Sisi was a little cloud. Sisi lived in the sky. Sisi liked to sing songs.  
One day, Sisi looked down and saw a boy named Ben in a yard. Ben had a red ball.  
Ben wanted the ball to go high. He said, "Sisi, help me."  
Sisi sang a song and blew a small wind. The ball went up, up, up.  
Ben laughed, but then the ball hit a tree.  
Ben felt sad and looked at Sisi.  
Sisi sang again, very gently. The wind moved the ball down to Ben's hands.  
Ben smiled big. He said, "Thank you, Sisi."  
Sisi smiled back.  
Ben played with the ball, and Sisi kept singing above the yard. The sky was blue, and both felt happy.

Pip was a tiny robot. Pip loved red apples. Pip was asleep in a teapot.  
One day, Pip went to the park. Pip saw a big red apple on the grass.  
Pip smiled. "Red apple!" said Pip. Pip ran to it.  
Then a bird came down and looked too. The bird wanted the apple.  
Pip felt sad, but Pip had an idea. Pip put the apple on a bench.  
The bird hopped near. Pip gave the bird a small leaf too.  
The bird liked the leaf. Pip liked the red apple.  
They sat by the bench and looked at the sky.  
The wind was soft and warm. Pip felt happy with the bird.  
When night came, Pip went home. Pip climbed into the teapot.  
Pip was asleep there, safe and cozy, with the red apple near.

Pip was a tiny robot. Pip loved red apples. Pip was asleep in a teapot.  
One day Pip went to the yard. Pip saw a big red apple on the grass. Pip smiled a tiny smile. He wanted it very much.  
But a bird sat on it. The bird looked at Pip and did not move. Pip felt sad.  
Then Pip waved and said, "Hello, bird."  
The bird heard his soft voice. It hopped away.  
Pip picked up the red apple. It was shiny and sweet.  
Pip took the apple home. He shared a piece with the bird.  
The bird sang. Pip smiled again.  
At night Pip was asleep in a teapot. The teapot was warm and cozy. Pip felt safe and happy.
